notes: STS-134's own GNC I-loads in G2 (GNC OPS 2) apart from the ascent/abort guidance compool #PCGGCOM: the rendezvous set of sts134-rndz-iloads.json plus every other #PCG*/#DG* csect word the PATCH SUMMARY of ~/workspace/PFS/mafgen/DASS_G2.ASC (STS-134's GNC2 listing, 'STS134/OI034/C2 MDD 134.09') changes from the load module's value (LM) to the flight's (MM), cross-checked against corrected-G2.fcm.  Includes the DAP's stored A/B configurations, notch filters and mass properties (#PCGCMFR), the star tracker mounting (#PCGYSTA, which needs YAGPC_STARTRK_MOUNT=flown so the simulated trackers match), and the rendezvous filter's initial covariance (#PCGEIPD, meant with fly_rndz134 --onboard-error flown).  #PCGGCOM (495 ascent/abort guidance words) is left out until an ascent trial.  Placed by fixed position on the KSC6 volume: each cell anchored on a distinctive run of a G2 OPS 1 IPL memory image and kept only at G2's own load block (offsets 109968 resident, 576000, 635804/635808, 643162, 649516, 649900, 1133994; #PCGCMFR at -75566).  Not placed (no reliable anchor, mostly GPS quality tables in #DGLJRCV and a few output masks): see RENDEZVOUS_PLAN 5n.  For fly_rndz134 --flight-gnc.
